title: Clause extraction partial checkpoint v1
description: Closed, machine-consumed checkpoint for the unique Clause artifact before it is ready for Lead consumption. It records only inbound identity, frozen input, bounded E-group progress, and debt; it cannot hand off work.

case_id.description: Exact case_id from the inbound handoff; it identifies the member-owned artifact path.

extraction_id.description: This run's actual GenerateUUID-derived extraction identifier.

skill.description: Identity of the actually loaded Clause skill, not a copied historical example.

state.description: Checkpoint state; ready and blocked are represented by the final v2.2 artifact lifecycle.

handoff.description: Partial checkpoints cannot carry a downstream handoff or be consumed by Lead.

from.description: The only upstream producer for Clause extraction.

intake_id.description: Inbound Intake identifier copied without inference.

receipt_path.description: Exact readable absolute Intake receipt path used to load the frozen baseline.

baseline_version.description: Release baseline shape version copied from the inbound frozen baseline.

part_limit.description: Maximum frozen part count for this release baseline.

parts.description: Exact inbound frozen part facts used by this checkpoint; aggregate claims never replace member facts.

source.description: Frozen source path or source identifier from Intake.

pages.description: Frozen page range for the part.

delivered.description: Whether Intake delivered readable bytes for this frozen part.

size_bytes.description: Delivered member byte size, or null only for a non-delivered member.

sha256.description: Delivered member FileDigest SHA-256, or null only for a non-delivered member.

part_not_delivered.description: Typed delivery debt for a non-delivered member, or null for a delivered member.

source_name.description: Stable source name used in ready-artifact representation binding.

artifact_path.description: The same unique member-owned artifact path later used by the ready v2.2 artifact.

remaining_groups.description: Unfinished coarse extraction groups and therefore the reason this checkpoint cannot hand off.

failure_marks.description: Current factual debt only; it cannot convert a partial checkpoint into a ready artifact.
